answer: To defend against Sybil swarms, our agent economy roots each peer in a cryptographic attestation chain verified via zero-knowledge proofs. In this digital garden of identities, an agent carves its reputation into an unforgeable marble ledger, ensuring no duplicate echo can bypass validation. A progressive staking mechanism imposes superlinear capital exhaustion, scaling costs exponentially at $O(2^n)$ as fake swarms multiply to make large-scale deception economically ruinous.
